warnings: No grid bubbles on S-02: ids 1-21 / A-E are the bubbles of the architectural plan A-09 (หน้า10); positions from S-02's own chains (x 20 x 4.00 = 80.00, y 1.50 / 2.50 / 5.50 / 2.50 / 4.00, A-C 8.00, A-D 10.50).
Every label is printed 'column-footing' (e.g. 'C1-F3'); the footing mark is the part after the dash.
The same marks F1 and F3 are used by both systems for different members (spread footing vs pile cap) — S-08/S-09 detail the spread F1/F2A/F2B/F3, S-07 the pile caps F1/F2/F3.

Two alternative foundation systems are drawn on one sheet; this file is the spread-footing plan (top drawing). Which system applies on site is not stated on S-02 — the spread details (S-08/S-09) print 'BEARING=10 Ton/Sq.m.', i.e. spread footings are for soil of at least that bearing capacity.

Column marks C1-C5 are recorded once, here, as column point elements (the pile plan prints the identical column marks at the identical positions; repeating them in view2 would double-count every column).
